# Qatar Airways Careers Portal (Taleo)

> Qatar Airways' talent acquisition and recruitment platform powered by Taleo, enabling job search, application submission, and candidate management with privacy-protected personal data handling.

This is Qatar Airways' dedicated careers portal built on the Taleo applicant tracking system. The site serves as the primary channel for external job seekers to discover positions, submit applications, and manage their recruitment journey while maintaining strict data protection and privacy compliance.

## Key Topics

- Qatar Airways
- Taleo
- Recruitment
- Talent Acquisition

## Job Search & Postings

- [Qatar Airways Job Detail](https://aa115.taleo.net/careersection/qa_external_cs/jobdetail.ftl): Qatar Airways job detail page via Taleo careers portal with position information and application access
- [Qatar Airways Job Posting Detail](https://aa115.taleo.net/careersection/QA_External_Conf_CS/jobdetail.ftl?lang=en&job=250000QR): Qatar Airways specific job posting detail and application page for individual positions

## Privacy & Data Protection

- [Job Search Privacy Agreement](https://aa115.taleo.net/careersection/qa_external_cs/jobsearch.ftl?lang=en): Qatar Airways talent acquisition privacy notice for job search outlining personal data handling and protection
- [Job Application Privacy Agreement](https://aa115.taleo.net/careersection/QA_CC_External_CS/jobapply.ftl?lang=en&job=2600000W): Qatar Airways recruitment privacy notice for job applications detailing data collection and protection practices
